title: Skill Overrides Manifest
description: Per-project overrides for the goodai-base skill evaluator hook. Place at .claude/skill-overrides.json in your project repo.

disabled.description: List of skill names to suppress from suggestions in this project. Use the skill's name field from skill-registry.json.

local_skills.description: Project-specific skills not in goodai-base. Each entry points to a local SKILL.md file that defines the skill's triggers and description.

name.description: Unique skill identifier (kebab-case). Must not conflict with goodai-base skill names.

path.description: Path to the SKILL.md file. Can be relative to the project root or absolute.

extra_context.description: Optional plain-text context string prepended to every skill suggestion block. Use this to add project-specific instructions or reminders that should appear alongside skill suggestions.
examples: This project uses bun instead of npm. Prefer bun commands.
Always check JIRA ticket before implementing.

examples.extra_context: This is a NestJS backend project. Check src/modules/ for module structure before implementing.
